name: io.github.onlsol/relay-remotify-mcp
description: Run shell commands on remote computers with optional per-command approval, using only curl and bash.

environmentVariables.name: REMOTIFY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Relay to talk to. Override to point at a self-hosted instance.

environmentVariables.name: REMOTIFY_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Reuse an existing session key instead of creating a new one on startup.
